  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

treatments like medication and home remedies, but nothing gives you long-lasting relief. **Capitol
Breathe Free Sinus and Allergy Centers offers evaluation and treatment options for a wide range of
sinus conditions that will bring you lasting relief.**

# Welcome to Doc Sinus!

Millions of Americans are affected by sinus infections, nasal obstruction and allergies.  These
disorders have a significant impact on quality of life and account for many days of loss
productivity and time off from work.  At Carolina Sinus Center, we are here to help.

Dr. Williams is the founder of Carolina Sinus Center and has a broad range of experience and
expertise in the medical and surgical treatment of allergy and sinus disorders. She also specializes
in in-office balloon sinus dilation, a minimally invasive procedure that offers lasting relief to
patient suffering from sinusitis.

As Otolaryngologists, our doctors are trained in the medical and surgical treatment of head and neck
disorders. We have special expertise in managing diseases of the ear, nose, sinuses, oral cavity and
pharynx (mouth and throat.)

Our ENT specialists are also trained to treat allergy, snoring, sleep apnea, infections and tumors
of the head and neck.

# Welcome to Doc Sinus!

Millions of Americans are affected by sinus infections, nasal obstruction and allergies.  These
disorders have a significant impact on quality of life and account for many days of loss
productivity and time off from work.  At Carolina Sinus Center, we are here to help.

Dr. Williams is the founder of Carolina Sinus Center and has a broad range of experience and
expertise in the medical and surgical treatment of allergy and sinus disorders. She also specializes
in in-office balloon sinus dilation, a minimally invasive procedure that offers lasting relief to
patient suffering from sinusitis.

As Otolaryngologists, our doctors are trained in the medical and surgical treatment of head and neck
disorders. We have special expertise in managing diseases of the ear, nose, sinuses, oral cavity and
pharynx (mouth and throat.)

Our ENT specialists are also trained to treat allergy, snoring, sleep apnea, infections and tumors
of the head and neck.

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.

Balloon Sinuplasty Conditions

## Who can benefit from balloon sinuplasty?

Balloon sinuplasty is a pain-free procedure that provides lasting relief for those suffering from
several chronic sinus issues. Balloon sinuplasty is simple and performed 100% in-office by Dr.
Michael Kaplan, who inserts and inflates a small balloon in your affected sinuses in order to
restore proper shape and airflow. Best of all, balloon sinuplasty is typically covered by most
insurance providers and Medicare.

Sinus snoring

[Chevron down]

### A snoring solution that works

Snoring is closely related to sinus health. Balloon sinuplasty stops snoring in its tracks by
opening blocked sinus cavities, allowing you to breathe easier through your nose during sleep.

[
[Arrow right thin]
Balloon Sinuplasty for Snoring][20]
[Woman laughing][Man smiling]

Frequent infections

[Chevron down]

### Finally, real freedom from chronic sinusitis

Chronic sinusitis balloon sinuplasty targets the source of chronic sinus infections by opening
blocked sinus cavities, providing you with long-term freedom from symptoms and future infections.

[
[Arrow right thin]
Balloon Sinuplasty for Chronic Sinusitis][21]
[Man cycling][Smiling woman]

Sinus headaches

[Chevron down]

### Eliminate chronic sinus headaches at the source

Balloon sinuplasty improves your sinus cavities’ ability to drain built-up mucus, reducing pressure
and relieving painful sinus headache symptoms.

[
[Arrow right thin]
Balloon Sinuplasty for Sinus Headaches][22]
[Woman waking up][Child smiling]

[Chevron down]

### Put an end to your chronic cough

Wondering how to get rid of your chronic cough? Balloon sinuplasty opens your sinus cavities so that
excess post nasal drip can drain properly and you can finally find relief from your chronic cough.

[
[Arrow right thin]
Balloon Sinuplasty for Chronic Cough][23]

Balloon sinuplasty opens your sinus passageways, preventing allergy-related infections, restoring
proper drainage, and allowing you to breathe freely again.

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

[ About Mount Bonnell ][28]

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

[ About Mount Bonnell ][28]

# Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

## Supported Robot Brands

RoboDK supports over 80 different robot manufacturers, providing access to an extensive robot
library.

# Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

## Supported Robot Brands

RoboDK supports over 80 different robot manufacturers, providing access to an extensive robot
library.

Simple  •  Reusable  •  Effective

Easy to use for the physician, cost savings for the practice. Win, Win.

## SIMPLE FAST PROCEDURES

Due to our simple and ergonomic design experienced surgeons may see a significant reduction in
operative time as compared to disposable dilation systems. The Simplicity® Solid Dilators come in
multiple sizes and have dilation tips at both ends to quickly dilate the sinuses.

## AFFORDABLE & REUSABLE

Simplicity® Dilators are low cost and reusable. One set may pay for itself after a small number of
procedures. Use of the Simplicity® Dilators is reimbursed by most insurance companies and Medicare
under sinus dilation procedures.

## VERY EFFECTIVE

Simplicity® Dilators are both low risk and effective in patients of all ages. When surveyed, our
patients experienced positive and improved short and long term results.* The rates of improved
symptoms* are similar to those of more complicated devices and procedures without the additional
risk of device failure.

## BILLABLE PROCEDURE

Procedures performed using Simpilcity® Dilators are billable using standard dilation codes including
codes 31295, 31296, 31297, and 31298.

## Designed by a Physician, for Physicians

• MADE IN THE USA •

## Simplicity ENT Sinus Dilators are made with medical grade stainless steel and built to last!

Simple  •  Reusable  •  Effective

Easy to use for the physician, cost savings for the practice. Win, Win.

## SIMPLE FAST PROCEDURES

Due to our simple and ergonomic design experienced surgeons may see a significant reduction in
operative time as compared to disposable dilation systems. The Simplicity® Solid Dilators come in
multiple sizes and have dilation tips at both ends to quickly dilate the sinuses.

## AFFORDABLE & REUSABLE

Simplicity® Dilators are low cost and reusable. One set may pay for itself after a small number of
procedures. Use of the Simplicity® Dilators is reimbursed by most insurance companies and Medicare
under sinus dilation procedures.

## VERY EFFECTIVE

Simplicity® Dilators are both low risk and effective in patients of all ages. When surveyed, our
patients experienced positive and improved short and long term results.* The rates of improved
symptoms* are similar to those of more complicated devices and procedures without the additional
risk of device failure.

## BILLABLE PROCEDURE

Procedures performed using Simpilcity® Dilators are billable using standard dilation codes including
codes 31295, 31296, 31297, and 31298.

# The Toledo Clinic ENT

The Toledo Clinic ENT provides both comprehensive and compassionate care of ear, nose and throat
conditions for children and adults in the Northwest Ohio and Southeast Michigan areas.

Dr. Christopher Perry is board certified in Otolaryngology and Facial Plastic Surgery, and assists
in the management of patients with allergy, nasal and sinus problems. Dr. Perry has advanced
training and expertise in Balloon Sinuplasty and Rhinoplasty (cosmetic and functional nasal
